onsite_service: Organization locations only; feasibility and travel fee quoted by staff. No home visits.
discount_policy: No automatic discount. Only a server-issued promotion approved by an authorized manager may change a quote.
cancellation_policy: Free reschedule or cancellation request >=24 hours before the slot. Less than 24 hours or any refund requires staff assessment. A request is not an approved refund.
refund_policy: Staff reviews paid-order refunds; no guaranteed approval or processing time is promised.
results_policy: Completion estimates and preparation instructions must come from a verified service record or staff; no universal fasting rule or invented turnaround.
payment_policy: PromptPay/card sandbox and pay at center. A screenshot is not proof of settlement. Never collect card numbers in chat.
privacy_policy: Only synthetic data in coursework. Employer receives coordination information, never employee lab details by default. Production consent, retention and data-processing agreements require separate approval.
handoff_policy: Active hours Mon-Sat 07:00-16:00 Asia/Bangkok. Outside hours create a ticket without promising immediate response. Urgent health concerns must not wait for this queue.
